name: BEAN & BLOOM
description: Bringing people together over handcrafted coffee, delicious beverages, and unforgettable café moments.
target_audience: College students, young professionals, coffee enthusiasts, families, and urban lifestyle consumers aged 18–40.
style_block: Create a premium international coffeehouse brand identity inspired by modern specialty café culture. Use forest green, warm cream, rich coffee brown, and subtle golden accents. Feature elegant takeaway cups, handcrafted espresso, cappuccino, iced coffee, frappes, latte art, and freshly baked pastries. Use sophisticated typography, a distinctive original botanical coffee-inspired emblem, warm lighting, natural wood textures, and welcoming café interiors. The overall visual style should feel premium, cozy, modern, friendly, recognizable, and aspirational. Maintain consistent branding across coffee cups, packaging, storefronts, menus, advertisements, and social media campaigns.
